name: LONICERA XYLOSTEUM
key_symptoms: Congestion of head and chest; coma. Contraction of one pupil and dilatation of the other. Sopor, eyes half open red face.
Jerking of limbs. Trembling of whole body. Violent convulsions. Limbs and head fall over as if paralyzed. Extremities cold. Cold perspiration.
